note: docs/PLAN.md section 5, rule 1: one owner per path. A change across the line goes through a request in handoff/, never an edit. Patterns are globs relative to the repository root: ** crosses folders, * does not, matching ignores case.

shared.note: Shared by the Director. any_device: both devices write here on their own branch (requests, hourly status, ledger rows, dev log material). director_only: changed by the Director on main; a device that needs a change files a handoff request.
